title: EGB Corpus Relation / Compression Map V3

relation_types.CORRECTS: Later source changes a formula, interpretation, or endpoint status of an earlier source.
relation_types.STRATEGICALLY_DOWNGRADES: Earlier exact mathematics survives, but its proposed route to the hard problem is downgraded.
relation_types.COMPILES: Artifact collects or reorganizes source artifacts as an entry point.
relation_types.EXACT_CONCATENATION: Artifact is mechanically verified as a concatenation of source files plus fixed separators/title.
relation_types.EXTRACTS_MODULE: Artifact presents a standalone module also contained in a larger proof corpus.
relation_types.COMPANION_CODE: Executable regression/calibration companion; not independent theorem content.
relation_types.MANIFESTS: Machine-readable status/metadata manifest for another artifact.
relation_types.VISUAL_DESCENDANT: PDF/image presentation derived from a text artifact.
relation_types.EXACT_TEMPLATE_STREAM: Large artifact generated by an exactly verified repeated template/body.
relation_types.THEMATIC_TRANSMISSION: Self-contained reconstruction of a selected mature spine, not the whole corpus.
relation_types.REGENERATIVE_SCORE: Compact symbolic/pedagogical score intended to regenerate broad structure.
relation_types.SUPERSEDES_INDEX: Later index supersedes earlier snapshot coverage or interpretive state while retaining it as provenance.
relation_types.EVIDENCE_FOR_INDEX: Machine-readable audit/evidence companion for an index.
relation_types.ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSURE: Administrative coverage artifact closing a dated source snapshot.
relation_types.NONFORGETTING_REQUIREMENT: Compression is lawful only if the named semantic/proof/provenance coordinate is preserved or its loss is explicit.
